# Urbano Market

<!-- Generated from manifest.json by scripts/build.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Online general-merchandise retailer in Uruguay on Shopify. Sells decoration and lighting, school and office supplies, home and kitchen goods, children's products and toys, watches and thermoses. States shipping across Uruguay mainly through DAC, free above a stated threshold.

*ES:* Comercio online de artículos generales en Uruguay sobre Shopify. Vende decoración e iluminación, útiles escolares y de oficina, hogar y cocina, productos infantiles y juguetes, relojes y termos. Indica envíos a todo el país principalmente por DAC, gratis por encima de un monto indicado.
